dedupe_keys.name: zones de deploiement du reseau fibre

description: Zones de déploiement du réseau fibre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Identification of fibre deployment zoning in the regional territory. 4 zones are distinguished here: \- Call Zones for Investment Intention Station (AMII) where private operators have committed to deploy and connect fibre by 2022 \- Local Commitments Call Areas where a call for tenders has been launched by local authorities to deploy and connect fibre ... Coverage: Région Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. The portal shows the English title as "Fibre network deployment areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Its keywords include amii, internet, thd, amel, reseaux-de-communication, tres-haut-debit. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, SHP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
